contexts.title: Project Architecture & Tech Stack
contexts.summary: Full-stack Crowdfunding platform with React (Vite) frontend and Node.js/Express backend.
contexts.solution: Frontend: React 19, Vite, Tailwind. Backend: Express 5, Mongoose.

contexts.title: Authentication System (JWT/Cookies)
contexts.summary: Authentication uses JWT stored in httpOnly cookies.
contexts.solution: Backend: jwt.js utils for signing, authMiddleware.js for verification.

contexts.title: Campaign Management & Approval Flow
contexts.summary: Creators can create campaigns. Admin approval required.

contexts.title: Payment Integration (SSLCommerz & Stripe)
contexts.summary: Dual payment gateway support: SSLCommerz (BDT) and Stripe (USD).

contexts.title: Secure Registration & Creator Approval Flow
contexts.summary: Multi-step registration with NID and Address verification for creators.
contexts.solution: User model updated for NID storage. Register.jsx uses 3-step flow.

contexts.title: Multi-Donation Reward & Unique Counting
contexts.summary: Updated reward eligibility to be based on cumulative contributions to a project.
contexts.solution: Backend groups donations by user. Frontend matches total raised against all qualifying tiers.

contexts.title: 70/30 Withdrawal Split & Platform Fees
contexts.summary: Implemented 10% platform fee and 70/30 payout split based on backer confirmation.
contexts.solution: Withdrawal model updated. Rules added to WITHDRAWAL_RULES.md. New Financial Studio tab.

contexts.title: Dashboard Lazy Loading & Caching
contexts.summary: Refactored dashboard to fetch data only for the active tab to improve speed.
contexts.solution: Implemented tab-specific fetching logic and a simple session cache.

contexts.title: Navbar Auto-Close & Dev Test Tools
contexts.summary: Added 3s auto-close to profile menu and deadline control buttons for testers.
contexts.solution: Used useEffect for timer. Added Expire Now/Reset buttons to Edit Campaign.

contexts.title: Detailed Withdrawal Cards & Stage Tracking
contexts.summary: Enhanced the admin and creator withdrawal views with detailed financial breakdowns. Added stage tracking (70/30 split) to the Withdrawal model and updated logic to identify Stage 1 vs Stage 2 automatically. UI now shows Net Payout, Gross, Platform Fee, and Stage Badge.
contexts.solution: 1. Modified Withdrawal.js model to include 'stage' field. 2. Updated paymentRoutes.js to determine stage during creation and populate campaign financial data. 3. Updated Dashboard.jsx to render detailed withdrawal cards in both Admin Finance and Creator Payments tabs.

contexts.title: Granular Reward Confirmation & Financial Integrity
contexts.summary: Fixed a bug where confirming one reward confirmed all project rewards. Switched to tier-level confirmation tracking in the Donation model and updated withdrawal logic to use this granular data for the 80% confirmation threshold.
contexts.solution: 1. Added 'confirmedRewardTierIds' to Donation.js. 2. Updated confirm-delivery route to accept tierId. 3. Recalculated confirmationRate in withdrawal-stats and fulfillment-monitor using tier-level counts. 4. Updated Dashboard.jsx UI for granular status tracking.

contexts.title: Universal Notification System Architectural Plan
contexts.summary: Designed a comprehensive notification strategy for the MERN platform targeting Creators, Backers, and Admins. The plan includes real-time (Socket.io), In-app (DB), and Email layers.
contexts.solution: 1. Triggers: New contributions, Payout updates, Goal milestones, Verification status, and Fraud alerts. 2. Implementation: Notification model (recipient, type, message, link, isRead). 3. UI: Navbar bell icon with unread indicator and Real-time Toasts.

contexts.title: Critical Build Fixes & Creator Updates UI Implementation
contexts.summary: Resolved critical build-breaking parse errors in Dashboard.jsx and CampaignDetails.jsx. Implemented the missing 'Campaign Updates' management interface for creators in the Dashboard.
contexts.solution: 1. Removed trailing junk code in Dashboard.jsx. 2. Fixed missing default export and state in CampaignDetails.jsx. 3. Added 'updates' tab to Creator Studio with post/delete functionality.

contexts.title: Dashboard Features, Form Validations, and Notification Fixes
contexts.summary: Implemented password change functionality, enforced strict form requirements for campaigns and creator applications, fixed broken notification links via code updates and a DB migration, and enhanced homepage routing with deep-linking support.
contexts.solution: 1. Added password change feature to SettingsTab (frontend & backend route). 2. Made all fields mandatory in CreatorApplicationModal and CreateCampaign (all phases). 3. Fixed incorrect notification links in campaignRoutes.js and paymentRoutes.js (e.g., my-campaigns -> my-projects). 4. Executed a migration script (fixNotificationLinks.js) to correct 8 existing broken links in MongoDB. 5. Updated homepage banner buttons to route to /explore with type=reward/charity filters. 6. Added a 'Coming Soon' modal for Forgot Password on the Login page. 7. Created SETUP_GUIDE.md for cross-device setup.

contexts.title: UI Redesign Phase 1 & 2: Color and Typography
contexts.summary: Overhauled the color system to a Sea Green minimalist theme and refactored global typography/spacing.
contexts.solution: Implemented new color tokens, halved all padding/margin values, and reduced font weights across 40+ JSX files.

contexts.title: UI Redesign Project Completion: Modern Minimalism
contexts.summary: Completed the comprehensive UI redesign project across all five phases. The application now features a consistent, professional, and 'alive' sea-green minimalist aesthetic.
contexts.solution: 1. Standardized color and typography (Phases 1-2). 2. Restructured Campaign Details layout and global padding (Phase 3). 3. Implemented Modern Flat Design for all components (Phase 4). 4. Finalized global polish including hero sections, partner strips, and subtle transitions (Phase 5).

contexts.title: UI Redesign Phase 4: Modern Flat Design Overhaul
contexts.summary: Implemented a Modern Flat Design across the entire application, focusing on minimalist components with rounded-lg (12px) corners, subtle borders, and solid backgrounds.
contexts.solution: Restyled CampaignCard, CampaignDetails, Home, Explore, Navbar, Footer, and Dashboard components (Sidebar, StatCard, Tabs, Modals) to remove gradients, heavy shadows, and extreme radii. Standardized on sea-green focus states and subtle shadow-sm.

contexts.title: Final Redesign Roadmap (Phases 3-5)
contexts.summary: Received and recorded definitive instructions for Layout Restructuring, Modern Flat Component Design, and Global Visual Polish.
contexts.solution: Saved detailed directives to NEXT_PHASES.md for sequential execution.
